title: The first green: stepping out onto the farm
about: Spring 6, 07:00, just outside the farmhouse door, the morning after the first green, before the farmer has stepped out: the farm builds green with the straw drawn over it, and as the door wipe opens the straw dissolves into green outward from the farmer (about 1.2 s, a dithered edge; a crossfade in Calm mode), with the FIRST GREEN banner and the birdsong swelling back. The dry tileset is held for this one morning and released at the next sleep.
